text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер finishes the race with
splendid
results.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But it seems Марузенски's absence is
still
weighing on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сэйун Скай feels ignored, admitting
frustration at
how dismissive Grass
Wonder is of the rivals right
in front of
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Only then does Грасс Вандер realize
she hasn't
truly clashed with her
contemporaries.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
